title: Transform Legacy Systems into Strategic Assets: Code Modernization with AI
description:
Join Anthropic and Deloitte for a webinar on how leading enterprises are using agentic AI to accelerate modernization initiatives, from legacy COBOL migrations to microservices transformations.

Discover how enterprises are using Claude Code and tested AI driven software development life cycle frameworks to achieve modernization outcomes in weeks, not years, while preserving critical business logic and reducing risk.
